title: Fair-MPC: a control-oriented framework for socially just decision-making
reasoning: The paper focuses on engineering and mathematical control theory, specifically proposing a 'Fair Model Predictive Control' scheme. While it uses concepts like equality and equity to formulate its control objectives, it does so within the context of resource allocation in dynamical systems. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics in the humanistic or theological sense, nor does it deal with Large Language Models.
